page.overview:
Who is Meteorito Jr.?

Meteorito Jr. was originally great with aerial techniques, his special move being a modified moonsault press named . When he fought Antler Inoki in Japan, his neck was injured by Inoki's abdominal stretch. Afterwards he began using the spinebuster instead. He is an excellent trainer, having a dojo in Mexico where he raised many great luchadores.

Apparently, Meteorito Jr. is an Aerophobic, as he is afraid of planes, and most likely flying in general. This may be related to the neck injury that caused him to stop using the Yucatán Tornado aerial technique.
